outcome: Large for Gestational Age (LGA) at birth
cohort: The study included pregnant women from a subcohort of the Pregnancy Outcome Prediction study (n=281) and an external validation cohort from the Born in Bradford (BiB) study (n=2366).
finding: A maternal serum 4-metabolite ratio, previously developed for fetal growth restriction, was found to be predictive of Large for Gestational Age (LGA) birth weight and inversely associated with birth weight across the whole range.
birth_weight: Large for Gestational Age (>90th percentile) and birth weight z-score.
gest_age: Metabolite measurements were taken at 24-28 weeks and 36 weeks gestational age; LGA was predicted at term.
